limits: Only exact L1/L2 cells have graded release; the rest of the network uses the previous spiking model.
Reversal is applied only to inhibitory mapped R1-R6 input onto L1/L2; other inhibitory pathways remain unbounded.
Release gain, time discretization and reversal values are unfitted.
These are causal routing checks, not biological calibration, visual recognition or spontaneous exploration.
